log: OrbitalGasBarrage 0.2.0 BUILD: select Orbital Gas Barrage in the custom panel, then a mission; call it with RIGHT RIGHT DOWN LEFT DOWN LEFT.

stratagems.name: ORBITAL GAS BARRAGE
stratagems.description: A prolonged caustic barrage, spreading corrosive gas over a large area. Causes confusion and blindness on those affected. Breathing it in is not advised.
